address: 26 Soi Sukhumvit 11, Khlong Toei Nuea, Vadhana, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: This Orient Express-themed restaurant aims to take diners on a journey from east to north-east Thailand via flavoursome cooking that joins culinary elements from Isan and the province of Trat. The ground floor is designed to look like a luxury train bar – perfect for enjoying one of their many signature cocktails –  then the 1st and 2nd floors resemble the business and first-class carriages respectively. The well-priced dishes use recipes from the owner’s mother. Booking is essential....
